text: Governor, if you once saw a UFO, if you were president, would you reopen and acquire it?
Well, no. But I would make information that we have about those sightings available to the public that I didn't sign.
I never have tried to identify. What I saw, it was a light in the western sky.
It was very unique. I'd never seen it before. There were about 20 of us who saw it.
None of us could figure out what it was.
I don't think it was anything solid, it looked to me like just a light.
It was a very, a huge aberration.
So I don't make fun of people who say they've seen unidentified objects in the sky.
You know these things used to have the body of the investigative UF force, but that's been discontinued.
